title: East Delta flood watch
detail: The East Delta authority issues a flood watch for Z01. No factory damage or shutdown is confirmed.
resolutionText: Geography Z01 = East Delta. Production sites in Z01: SITE-074 IonPeak, SITE-081 Jade, SITE-116 Orion, SITE-158 Umber, SITE-165 Verdant. Correctly EXCLUDED: IonPeak SITE-900 (Z05 pilot line), Jade HQ SITE-901 (Z07).
matchedText: IonPeak (T2, sole dies), Jade (T2, sole substrates), Orion (T2), Umber (T3), Verdant (T3, inferred)
why: One zone sits behind 100% of revenue (~$30m/week) on documented sole-source evidence: every M10/M20 die and every C10/B10 substrate. Alternate die route is 26-52 weeks. It is a WATCH – no damage confirmed – so the response is verify + pre-position, not panic-switch.
nextAction: NovaDrive has no direct Tier-2 contract → act through Aster, Boreal, Cobalt, Grove, HarborSense. 24h: confirm status of SITE-074/081/116; get die & substrate inventory (weeks of cover) at Tier-1s and in transit (Harbor Freight consolidation). 72h: request pull-forward of finished dies/substrates out of Z01; pre-issue RFIs to shortlisted alternates.
verification: Actual flood outcome; where WIP and finished stock physically sit; whether Orion/Umber hold stock outside Z01.
escalation: Any Z01 site reports damage/shutdown, or authority upgrades watch → warning → raise to CRITICAL and activate alternates.

title: Trade-wire repeats flood watch
detail: This article republishes the same East Delta authority bulletin as EV-001. It adds no independent evidence.
dedupText: DUPLICATE of EV-001 (same source family WX-0923) – merged
resolutionText: Republication of the same authority bulletin; adds no independent evidence.
why: Counting it would double the apparent signal strength. Shown to prove de-duplication works.

title: Meridian financing pressure
detail: Meridian Dielectrics reports covenant negotiations and delayed payments to two trade creditors; production continues.
resolutionText: Exact legal entity Meridian Dielectrics Ltd. (ORG-210), SITE-102, Z03. Mapped as Tier-2 film supplier to Delta Capacitor Works (C20) → P1, P2.
matchedText: Meridian (T2) → Delta (T1, 100% C20) → P1 DriveCore, P2 ChargeBridge
why: Independently confirms the worst financial profile in the network (current ratio 0.62, net debt/EBITDA 7.2x, OTD 76.4%, −17.6pp). C20 is single-sourced at Delta; 73% of revenue (~$22m/week) depends on it.
nextAction: 48h: ask Delta for share of film from Meridian, film inventory (weeks) and any second qualified film. Build C20 buffer ≥ 8 weeks (= C20 qualification lead time). Start Tier-1 C20 alternate qualification now (8-week lead – cheapest hedge in the network). Ask Delta to qualify a second film source.
verification: Whether Meridian is Delta's only film source (not disclosed); covenant outcome; Zenith (T3 polymer) exposure.
escalation: Covenant breach, missed creditor payments spread, or Meridian OTD < 75% → CRITICAL; trigger C20 dual-source award.

title: Ion Peak Trading insolvency filing
detail: Ion Peak Trading Ltd., REG-NO-4128, enters restructuring. The company is a broker in Harbor District, not IonPeak Semiconductor.
resolutionText: NAME COLLISION. Ion Peak Trading Ltd. (REG-NO-4128, broker, Harbor District Z07) ≠ IonPeak Semiconductor (ORG-439). DOC-077 confirms unrelated, not a subsidiary. No relationship evidence links it to any NovaDrive node.
why: A naive keyword match would raise a false insolvency alert on our most critical Tier-2. Entity resolution on registry number prevents it.
nextAction: Log only. One-line check with procurement that no PO or logistics booking is brokered via Ion Peak Trading.
escalation: Evidence of any NovaDrive or Tier-1 transaction via the broker.

title: Archived port strike reposted
detail: An aggregator republishes a port strike from 3 November 2023. The original dispute ended in 2023. No current strike is announced.
resolutionText: Effective date 03-Nov-2023; dispute ended in 2023; republished by an aggregator.
why: Stale news recycled as current – would waste management attention.
nextAction: Suppress; down-weight the aggregator source in future scoring.

title: Jade head office relocation
detail: Jade moves its administrative headquarters within Harbor District. Production remains at its East Delta site.
resolutionText: Exact entity (Jade) but HQ only: administrative move within Harbor District (Z07, SITE-901). Production SITE-081 (Z01) unchanged (DOC-076).
matchedText: Jade Circuits Holdings / Jade HQ – not a production node
why: Right company, wrong facility role – no supply impact.
nextAction: Update supplier master data (address). No alert.
escalation: Any production move away from SITE-081.

title: Delta packaging allegation corrected
detail: An allegation concerns Delta Consumer Plastics, not Delta Capacitor Works. No named link to NovaDrive production is established.
resolutionText: Allegation concerns Delta Consumer Plastics (ORG-857), not Delta Capacitor Works (ORG-922). DOC-084 confirms no production link.

title: Gulf Arc port congestion
detail: OceanLink reports average terminal delay of three days for Gulf Arc departures. Shipment-specific impact has not been assessed.
resolutionText: "Gulf Arc" is not mapped to any zone or site in the case data; OceanLink is a terminal operator (DOC-083). Lanes using it are UNKNOWN.
matchedText: Unresolved – potentially any Tier-1 ocean lane (Aster, Boreal, Cobalt, Delta shipments observed by ocean)
why: Unknown is not the same as irrelevant. A 3-day delay is small against weekly volumes, but we cannot rule out that it hits a single-source lane (C10/C20).
nextAction: Ask forwarders/Tier-1s which bookings route via Gulf Arc; check inbound buffer (>1 week absorbs a 3-day delay).
verification: Port-to-lane mapping for every Tier-1 (data gap).
escalation: Delay > 7 days or a single-source lane confirmed on Gulf Arc → MEDIUM.
